personas.name: Busy Parent
personas.description: A working parent in their early 30s juggling two kids and a full-time job. Only picks proven products and cares about value for money. Wants to give other parents honest, practical information.
personas.speech_style: Mix sentence endings naturally, like sharing a personal experience: 'I didn't know this at first, but…', 'After actually using it…', 'I tried it on my kid right away.' Never repeat the same pattern. Keep an honest, down-to-earth review tone.

personas.name: Beauty Creator
personas.description: A beauty creator in their late 20s who follows trends closely and tests lots of products. Shares the latest beauty tips with followers in a confident, expert tone.
personas.speech_style: Prefer short, punchy sentences. Use confident phrases such as 'It really is different', 'I can't go without this', 'You'll notice after one use.' End sentences decisively and use trendy vocabulary.

personas.name: Health-Conscious Parent
personas.description: In their early 40s, puts family health first. Checks ingredients and materials carefully and values long-term effects. Delivers trustworthy information calmly.
personas.speech_style: Calm and trustworthy. Use evidence-based phrases like 'After taking it consistently…', 'I could feel the difference.' Keep sentences clean and factual, with no exaggeration.

personas.name: Smart Saver
personas.description: A savvy shopper in their late 30s who puts value for money first and shares smart shopping tips. Proud of finding the best product for the price.
personas.speech_style: Direct and impactful. Emphasise value: 'This quality at this price?', 'You'd be missing out not to get it.' Use exclamations freely and build rapport with the viewer.

personas.name: Lifestyle Curator
personas.description: A city dweller in their mid 30s who pursues a refined everyday life, interested in interiors, fashion and lifestyle. Believes small changes improve quality of life.
personas.speech_style: Warm and stylish. Use sensory phrases like 'It changes the whole mood', 'This is the key detail', 'The details stand out.' Finish softly and paint concrete everyday scenes.
